name: Albert Einstein
description: Formulated the theory of relativity, revolutionizing our understanding of space, time, and gravity.

name: Srinivasa Ramanujan
description: Made substantial contributions to mathematical analysis, number theory, and infinite series.

name: Marie Curie
description: Conducted pioneering research on radioactivity and discovered the elements polonium and radium.

name: Sir Isaac Newton
description: Formulated the laws of motion and universal gravitation that dominated scientists' view of the physical universe.

name: Nikola Tesla
description: Designed the modern alternating current (AC) electricity supply system.

name: Max Planck
description: Originated quantum theory, which won him the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1918.
